title: Drop the folder-exchange test fixture's TempHome after its two hosts, so Windows can delete the temp directory
outcome: Drop the folder-exchange test fixture's TempHome after its two hosts, so Windows can delete the temp directory
acceptance: The task_sync_folder_counts and task_sync_folder_recovery tests pass on Windows with no 'Engram test fixture cleanup FAILED ... (os error 32)' line and no 'Temp fixture leak' in the run's final temp audit
The test fixture releases every store and file handle its hosts hold before it removes its temporary home, on every platform
